name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Clause 2 is mis‑interpreted. The task says 'If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.' This is an 'if' condition with no timing cue, so according to the template mapping it must be a hard RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box) (i.e. (F(at_exit) -> F(holding_box))). The candidate uses a Response(at_exit, holding_box) and also rewrites the wording to 'Whenever the agent is at the exit…', which changes the semantics. Replace the clause (and the corresponding machine rule) with a hard RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box) instead of Response.

texts: If the box falls, the very next step must have the agent holding the box.
If you get to the exit, you must be holding the box.
The agent must eventually reach the exit.
